optical_parameters.task: Rank satellite-observed fragments for prospective follow-up of future spectral declines, NOT usefulness of agronomist inspection.
optical_parameters.outcome: Any NDVI or NDMI core median decline<=-0.10 on nearest same-baseline6-8day clear scene, same prior labels; unknown if unavailable.
optical_parameters.human_labels: No human visits, crop/harvest/damage/usefulness labels. Cannot train an inspection-usefulness model.
optical_parameters.budget_status: Research comparison budget only; not an agreed field visit schedule.
optical_parameters.issue_pool: ALL eligible original archive observations with a prior same-baseline clear core2-21days earlier. Never require a future scene. Core>=10cells/.8clear. Same UTC-day dedup as frozen observations.
optical_parameters.timing: Issue at end of acquisition UTC day; retrospective reprocessed archive availability at actual historical issue time unproven.
optical_parameters.quality: Input pair only: common pixels and all11 boundary scenarios. Missing boundary support explicit; never exclude a candidate for lack of future outcome.
optical_parameters.robust_change: max(0, worst decline persisting across ALL11 common-pixel boundary scenarios)*7/pastlag. Missing complete support => score0, candidate kept.
optical_parameters.fallback: recent_drop ordering when training support insufficient. No synthetic event examples.
optical_parameters.folds_rule: Train completed known2024 target<monthstart, nonreserved. Rank EVERY input candidate in validation month. Targets>=nextmonth masked unknown for scoring, NOT dropped from ranking. No field/date splitting within a round.
optical_parameters.selection: 2024 ONLY. Same topmin(K,poolsize) slots. Retain every known baselineTP identity, strictly positive mean paired precision lower bound and no possible increase of negatives, including unknown outcomes. Max lower difference, then knownTP, listed method order. Else recent_drop retained.
optical_parameters.missing: Known positive=1, known negative=0, unavailable=None. Precision lower=TP/slots, upper=(TP+unknown)/slots. Shared choices cancel in paired difference; unmatched unknowns take worst/best values. NOT statistical confidence intervals.
optical_parameters.tie: sha256 fixed seed + fragmentID only for equal scores; no observed outcome or target used.
optical_parameters.final_fit: All known nonreserved2024 labels only. Validation estimates optimistic due repeated upstream development with2024.
optical_parameters.test: After frozen choice, selected method vs fixed recent_drop and robust_change on all2026 and reserved2024. Rejected learned methods NOT evaluated2026.2025 absent;2026 previously seen, not blind.
optical_parameters.deployment: Research artifact only; no task scheduling, no production promotion, no change to old point forecasts/detectors/intervals/UI/journal.
limitations: Future target availability is not guaranteed and may be informative.
Nearby approximate fragments are not confirmed fields; dates and overlapping windows dependent.
Future decline is not crop damage, yield loss or inspection usefulness.

feature_policy: Latest causal eligible same-platform/orbit/direction pair by UTC issue-day end. Actual common finite positive VV/VH cells>=10/.8. Latest<=18days old; previous4-36days. No interpolation, no pooling tracks, no future target required. Missing features=0 plus explicit indicators. All11 boundary sensitivity spans explicit, missing flagged.
input_availability: Retrospective acquired-by-issue-EOD data; actual historical RTC publication/receipt at that issue NOT proven. This is not a historical live forecast.
cohorts: Same699 original input candidates,368known/331unknown. Training original completed2024 pool excludingR23-R27. Known original targets unchanged; radar never fills unknown optical outcomes.
fitting: Same fixed LogisticC=.1 and ExtraTrees256/depth3/minleaf15/seed20241021. Optical-only controls must reproduce old OOF. For Jun-Oct fit on known nonreserved2024 target<monthstart, score every candidate in month. No future/current-month labels in fit or preprocessing.
selection: Development only: same min(3,N) slots. Retain EVERY known positive identity of baseline AND fixed candidate, knownFP<=both, worst-case paired negative growth<=0 vsboth and strict paired lower gain>0 vsboth. Choose largest minimum paired lower gain, then FP, declared order. Default fixed_candidate. No production/prospective promotion.
forward: Month-start selection using only prior OOF issue pools with completed target<monthstart; unknown candidates retained. Require20known/5dates else fixed_candidate. This inherited repeatedly inspected2024 is development, not independent validation.
quality_gate: ESA per-product RFI clearance UNKNOWN. Any statistical win remains exploratory; operational admission prohibited until independent source-QC and prospective validation.
